notes: Serbian Cyrillic yearbook (1900), clean print; random lines 1-20 and the all-caps headings 21-33 read correctly. The 'other language' lines (27, 30, 35) are genuine Russian / Church Slavonic citations with old letters (ъ, і) that the labels reproduce. The only recurring slip is superscript footnote numbers being dropped or read as '"'/'•' (2, 6, 16, 17), and a few single-letter confusions (15 'пана' for 'папа', 36 'Донста'); these are rare and not systematic.
